links.outcome: Anatomical accuracy and clinical usefulness of AI-generated illustrations rated by two MSK radiologists
links.effect: Gemini 3.0 Pro produced anatomically accurate illustrations in about 40-42% of cases and clinically useful images in 60-65%; ChatGPT and Perplexity frequently produced plausible images with substantial anatomical inaccuracies; major errors across all models.
links.quote: Major errors were observed across all models, particularly in complex cases involving multiple anatomical structures or imaging planes.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the feasibility and anatomical accuracy of commercial multimodal/generative AI systems in producing medical illustrations from radiology reports, evaluated offline by radiologists.
